text:
```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - '**/*.tsx'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.jsx'
      - '**/package.json'
      - '**/yarn.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/trigger-flaky.yml'

jobs:
  trigger-flaky-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          format: json

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@64ed1c7eab4cce3362f8c3408c57da6d72f25263 # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.17.1'
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive

      - name: Run flaky tests
        run: |
          yarn test:jest --testPathPattern=".*custom.*integration.*|.*integration.*upload.*" --passWithNoTests --verbose
        env:
          CI: true
          NODE_OPTIONS: "--max-old-space-size=8192"
```
